description: This file defines the ProviderStateManager class, which manages the states of providers within the Orleans framework, including state transitions and validation, as well as the ProviderState enum and a custom exception class ProviderStateException.

classes.name: ProviderState
classes.description: An internal enum representing the possible states of a provider: None, Initialized, Started, and Closed.

classes.name: ProviderStateManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the state of a provider, allowing presetting and committing states with validation logic.

classes.name: ProviderStateException
classes.description: A serializable, sealed exception class for provider state errors within Orleans.

methods.name: ProviderStateManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider's state to None.

methods.name: PresetState
methods.description: Sets a preset provider state after validating whether the transition is valid based on current state.

methods.name: CommitState
methods.description: Commits the preset state as the current state of the provider.

methods.name: ProviderStateException (constructors)
methods.description: Constructors for creating exception instances with different message and inner exception options.
